_comment: Levels, labels and customs [VERIFY] with a teacher of the country before the preset is advertised (PLAN.md 9.41). 高等学校 (full-time, three years): classes written 1年2組, as in jp-chugakko; some schools name them with letters or kana [VERIFY]. The part-time (定時制) and correspondence (通信制) courses may last four years, and the 中等教育学校 and 中高一貫校 keep lower and upper secondary in one school: add the levels of jp-chugakko [VERIFY]. Pupils come from the 3年 of jp-chugakko after the entrance examination, so there is no link between the two presets. The school year (年度) starts on 1 April and is named by its starting year, as in jp-chugakko [VERIFY]. Classes are re-formed at least when the pupils choose a course (文系, 理系) in the second year, and in many schools every year (クラス替え), so the promotion clears them [VERIFY]. After the 3年 a pupil leaves.
